pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel-level edge gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is significantly larger on the upper shoulder and flank, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometric forms on the lower limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent intersections. Pathway pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the primary flank but narrows noticeably on the lower extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour visible along the upper neck ridge, representing the 1D silhouette of a short, erect mane against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized, large textural disruption with irregular surface topography and grey-brown hyper-pigmentation on the mid-to-lower flank, consistent with a parasitic or dermatological lesion.
